jetbrains.caches.name: Old JetBrains IDE caches
jetbrains.caches.line: Caches of IDE versions you no longer use
jetbrains.caches.what: Files an older version of a JetBrains IDE kept to work faster, such as indexes and local history.
jetbrains.caches.made-by: A JetBrains IDE, such as IntelliJ IDEA or PyCharm, one folder per version.
jetbrains.caches.if-removed: Nothing you made is lost. Your current version keeps its own caches.
jetbrains.caches.comes-back: Only if you open that older version again, which then takes a few minutes to make them.
jetbrains.logs.name: Old JetBrains IDE logs
jetbrains.logs.line: Logs of IDE versions you no longer use
jetbrains.logs.what: Records of what an older version of a JetBrains IDE did, kept for finding problems.
jetbrains.logs.made-by: A JetBrains IDE, such as IntelliJ IDEA or PyCharm, one folder per version.
jetbrains.logs.if-removed: Nothing reads them any more. Your current version writes its own logs.
jetbrains.settings.name: Old JetBrains IDE settings
jetbrains.settings.line: Settings of IDE versions you no longer use
jetbrains.settings.what: The settings and plugins an older version of a JetBrains IDE used, such as keymaps and code styles.
jetbrains.settings.made-by: A JetBrains IDE, such as IntelliJ IDEA or PyCharm, one folder per version.
jetbrains.settings.if-removed: A newer version copies them when it first starts; if it did not, your own keymaps, code styles and templates are lost.
jetbrains.settings.comes-back: No. That older version would start with default settings.
jetbrains.uninstalled.name: Removed JetBrains IDE data
jetbrains.uninstalled.line: Data of JetBrains IDEs you removed
jetbrains.uninstalled.what: The settings, plugins, caches and logs a JetBrains IDE left behind after you removed it.
jetbrains.uninstalled.made-by: A JetBrains IDE, while it was installed; each item names it.
jetbrains.uninstalled.if-removed: If you install that IDE again, it starts from scratch, with default settings and no plugins.
jetbrains.enabled.label: JetBrains IDEs
jetbrains.enabled.description: Finds what JetBrains IDEs left behind: the settings, caches and logs of older versions, and the data of an IDE that is no longer installed.
jetbrains.uninstalled-after-days.label: Offer the data of a removed IDE after
jetbrains.uninstalled-after-days.descrip: The data of a JetBrains IDE that is no longer installed is offered only once none of it has changed for this many days, at least 7.
jetbrains.finding.title: {product} {version}
jetbrains.finding.uninstalled-reason: Left by {product} {version}. {product} is no longer installed, and none of its data has changed in the last {days} days.
jetbrains.left-out.current: This is the version you use.
jetbrains.left-out.newer: It belongs to a newer version than the one installed, so it is kept.
jetbrains.left-out.running: The IDE is open. Quit it and scan again to clean its older versions.
jetbrains.left-out.unknown-version: Fresher could not tell which version of this IDE you use, so it keeps every version of it.
jetbrains.left-out.no-system: Fresher could not list your apps, so it keeps every IDE version. Scan again; if this goes on, restart your Mac.
jetbrains.left-out.unknown-ide: Another JetBrains app that Fresher does not know is installed and may use this data, so it is kept.
jetbrains.left-out.installed-elsewhere: This IDE is installed outside your apps folders, so Fresher keeps its data.
jetbrains.left-out.used-recently: No installed IDE uses this data, but it changed within the days set in Settings, or comes from a restored or incomplete scan, so it is kept. A scan after those days offers it.
jetbrains.left-out.vendor-app-open: Another JetBrains app is open and may use this data. Quit it and scan again to clean older versions.
jetbrains.left-out.apps-unread: Fresher could not read every app in your apps folders, so it keeps every IDE version.
jetbrains.left-out.spotlight-unread: Fresher could not search every drive with Spotlight, so this IDE may be installed elsewhere and its data is kept. Turn Spotlight on, then scan again.
